```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

TABLE_NUMBER <- 0

print_aligned_table <- function(df, headers, sep = "     ", intro = NULL, wrap_verbatim = TRUE) {
  if (wrap_verbatim) cat("\\begin{verbatim}\n")
  if (!is.null(intro)) cat(intro)

  cols_aligned <- mapply(
    function(col, hdr) format(c(hdr, " ", as.character(col)), justify = "centre"),
    df,
    headers,
    SIMPLIFY = FALSE
  )
  df_aligned <- as.data.frame(cols_aligned, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  write.table(
    df_aligned,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE,
    quote = FALSE,
    sep = sep
  )
  cat("\n")
  if (wrap_verbatim) cat("\\end{verbatim}\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: sample_size

cat(paste0("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{\\textbf{Table ", TABLE_NUMBER, ".a) SAMPLE SIZE}}}\\vspace{5mm}"))
cat("\\begin{adjustwidth}{1cm}{0cm}\n")

df_samples <- readRDS("export/rds/df_samples.rds") |>
  mutate(Power = sprintf("%.2f", Power))

print_aligned_table(
  df_samples,
  headers = c("Power", "Delta = 0.3", "Delta = 0.4", "Delta = 0.5"),
  intro = "Given alpha = 0.05\n\n"
)

cat("\\end{adjustwidth}\n\\vspace{5mm}")
```

```{r}
df <- readRDS("export/rds/df_complete.rds")
df_powers <- readRDS("export/rds/df_powers.rds") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.2f", .)))

print_aligned_table(
  df_powers,
  headers = c("Delta = 0.3", "Delta = 0.4", "Delta = 0.5"),
  intro = paste("Given N =", nrow(df), "+ alpha = 0.05\n\n")
)
TABLE_NUMBER <- TABLE_NUMBER + 1

cat("\\end{adjustwidth}\n\\vspace{5mm}")
```

```{r}
#| label: descriptive
#| echo: false

cat(paste0("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{\\textbf{Table ", TABLE_NUMBER, ") DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS}}}\\vspace{5mm}"))
cat("\\begin{adjustwidth}{1cm}{0cm}\n\\begin{verbatim}\n")

df_descr <- readRDS("export/rds/df_descr.rds")

df_descr_1 <- df_descr |>
  select(var_name, n_valid, n_missing, mean, sd, ci_lower, ci_upper) |>
  mutate(
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .)),
    n_valid = as.integer(n_valid),
    n_missing = as.integer(n_missing)
  )
print_aligned_table(
  df_descr_1,
  headers = c("Variable", "N", "Missing", "Mean", "SD", "95%CI Low", "95%CI High"),
  wrap_verbatim = FALSE
)

cat("\n")

df_descr_2 <- df_descr |>
  select(var_name, min, q1, q2, q3, max, sw_p) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .)))
print_aligned_table(
  df_descr_2,
  headers = c("Variable", "Min", "Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Max", "Shapiro (p)"),
  wrap_verbatim = FALSE
)

TABLE_NUMBER <- TABLE_NUMBER + 1

cat("\\end{verbatim}\n\\vspace{5mm}\n")

for (var_name in df_descr$var_name) {
  descr_plot <- file.path("export/img", paste0("plot_descr_", var_name, ".pdf"))
  qq_plot <- file.path("export/img", paste0("plot_qq_", var_name, ".pdf"))
  if (file.exists(descr_plot) && file.exists(qq_plot)) {
    cat("\\vspace{5mm}")
    cat("\\begin{center}\n")
    cat(paste0("\\includegraphics[width=0.45\\textwidth]{", descr_plot, "}\n"))
    cat("\\hfill\n")
    cat(paste0("\\includegraphics[width=0.45\\textwidth]{", qq_plot, "}\n"))
    cat("\\end{center}\n")
  }
}

cat("\\end{adjustwidth}")
```

```{r}
#| label: comparison
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| out.width: "80%"

cat(paste0("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{\\textbf{Table ", TABLE_NUMBER, ") MULTIPLE COMPARISONS (\\underline{- complete cases only -})}}}\\vspace{5mm}"))

rds_files <- list.files(
  path = "export/rds",
  pattern = "^df_shapiro_.*\\.rds$",
  full.names = FALSE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)
var_names <- sub("^df_shapiro_", "", rds_files)
var_names <- sub("\\.rds$", "", var_names)
var_names <- var_names[!is.na(var_names) & var_names != ""]

for (name in var_names) {

  cat("\\begin{adjustwidth}{1cm}{0cm}\n")
  cat("\\begin{minipage}{\\linewidth}\n")
  cat(paste0("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{\\textbf{Table ", TABLE_NUMBER, ".", which(var_names == name), ") [", toupper(name), "] ANALYSIS}}}\\newline\\newline\n"))

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NORMALITY CHECK
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{· NORMALITY CHECK\\newline}}\n")
  df_shapiro <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_shapiro_", name, ".rds")) |> select(-2)
  df_shapiro_fmt <- df_shapiro |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .)))
  print_aligned_table(
    df_shapiro_fmt,
    headers = c("Time", "Statistic", "P-value", "Normality", "Mean", "Median")
  )

  if (all(df_shapiro$p > 0.05)) {
    cat("\\colorbox{yellow}{\\texttt{Normality RESPECTED --> ANOVA}}\\newline\\newline\n")

    # ANOVA
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    cat("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{· ANOVA ± CORRECTED ANOVA\\newline}}\n")
    df_anova <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_anova_", name, ".rds"))
    df_anova_fmt <- df_anova |>
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .)))
    print_aligned_table(
      df_anova_fmt,
      headers = c("Statistic", "DoF", "P-value", "P-Mauchly", "GG-epsilon")
    )

    if (df_anova$p_mauchly >= 0.05) {
      cat("\\colorbox{yellow}{\\texttt{p-Mauchly >= 0.05 -> No correction needed}}\\newline\\newline\n")
    } else {
      cat("\\colorbox{yellow}{\\texttt{p-Mauchly < 0.05 -> Correction needed}}\\newline\\newline\n")
      if (df_anova$gge < 0.75) {
        cat("\\colorbox{yellow}{\\texttt{GG-epsilon < 0.75 -> Greenhouse-Geisser correction}}\\newline\\newline\n")
      } else {
        cat("\\colorbox{yellow}{\\texttt{GG-epsilon >= 0.75 -> Huynh-Feldt correction}}\\newline\\newline\n")
      }
    }

    df_anova_corrected <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_anova_corrected_", name, ".rds")) |>
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .)))
    print_aligned_table(
      df_anova_corrected,
      headers = c("Statistic", "DoF", "P-value", "Correction")
    )

    # HOLM PAIRWISE COMPARISON
    cat("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{· HOLM PAIRWISE COMPARISON\\newline}}\n")
    df_pairwise <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_p_values_", name, ".rds")) |>
      select(group1, group2, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, statistic, effsize, p.adj) |>
      mutate(
        estimate = sprintf("%.2f", estimate),
        conf.low = sprintf("%.2f", conf.low),
        conf.high = sprintf("%.2f", conf.high),
        statistic = sprintf("%.2f", statistic),
        effsize = sprintf("%.2f", effsize),
        p.adj = case_when(
          p.adj < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
          TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.adj)
        )
      )
    print_aligned_table(
      df_pairwise,
      headers = c("Group 1", "Group 2", "Mean Diff", "95% CI Low", "95% CI High", "t", "Cohen's d", "P-value"),
      sep = "   "
    )

  } else {
    cat("\\colorbox{yellow}{\\texttt{Normality VIOLATED --> FRIEDMAN'S TEST}}\\newline\\newline\n")

    # FRIEDMAN TEST
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    cat("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{· FRIEDMAN'S TEST\\newline}}\n")
    df_friedman <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_friedman_", name, ".rds")) |>
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sprintf("%.3f", .)))
    print_aligned_table(
      df_friedman,
      headers = c("Chi squared", "DoF", "P-value")
    )

    # CONOVER PAIRWISE COMPARISON
    cat("\\textcolor{red}{\\texttt{· CONOVER PAIRWISE COMPARISON\\newline}}\n")
    df_conover <- readRDS(paste0("export/rds/df_conover_", name, ".rds")) |>
      select(Group1, Group2, med_diff, ci_lower, ci_upper, Statistic, p_value) |>
      mutate(
        med_diff = sprintf("%.2f", med_diff),
        ci_lower = sprintf("%.2f", ci_lower),
        ci_upper = sprintf("%.2f", ci_upper),
        Statistic = sprintf("%.2f", Statistic),
        p_value = case_when(
          p_value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
          TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_value)
        )
      )
    print_aligned_table(
      df_conover,
      headers = c("Group 1", "Group 2", "Median Diff", "95% CI Low", "95% CI High", "Statistic", "P-value"),
      sep = "   "
    )
  }

  current_file_path <- file.path("export", "img", paste0("plot_trend_", name, ".pdf"))
  if (file.exists(current_file_path)) {
    cat("\\vspace{7.5mm}")
    cat("\\begin{center}")
    current_plot <- normalizePath(current_file_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
    current_plot <- gsub("_", "\\_", current_plot, fixed = TRUE)
    cat(paste0("\\includegraphics[width=0.75\\textwidth]{{", current_plot, "}}"))
    cat("\\end{center}")
  }

  cat("\\end{minipage}\n")
  cat("\\end{adjustwidth}\n")
}
```
